transcript:
Speaker A (Son): पापा, आज स्कूल में टीचर ने पूछा, 'What does your father do?' मैंने बोला, 'My father works very hard.' टीचर ने स्माइल किया। पर मुझे पता है पापा, अगर आप खुद बोलते ना टीचर से, तो मुझे और अच्छा लगता। [Dad, today at school the teacher asked, 'What does your father do?' I said, 'My father works very hard.' The teacher smiled. But I know, Dad, if you had spoken to the teacher yourself, I would have felt even better.]
Speaker B (Father): बेटे ने मुझसे ये नहीं बोला कि इंग्लिश सीखो। उसने बोला, 'आप खुद बोलते तो अच्छा लगता।' वो शर्म नहीं कर रहा मुझसे, वो प्राउड होना चाहता है। और मैं उसे वो मौका नहीं दे पा रहा। मैं आज एक बात बोलना चाहता हूँ, अपने बेटे के सामने। [My son didn't tell me to learn English. He said, 'It would have been nice if you spoke yourself.' He is not ashamed of me, he wants to feel proud. And I am not giving him that opportunity. Today, I want to say something in front of my son.]
Speaker A (Son): क्या पापा? [What, Dad?]
Speaker B (Father): बेटा, मुझे तुझसे माफ़ी माँगनी है। [Son, I need to apologize to you.]
Speaker A (Son): क्यों पापा? [Why, Dad?]
Speaker B (Father): क्योंकि जब तू मुझसे बोलता था पीटीएम में आओ, मैं बहाने बनाता था। ऑफिस है, मीटिंग है, तबियत नहीं है। सच ये था, मुझे शर्म आती थी। तेरी स्कूल में सब इंग्लिश में बात करते हैं। तेरे दोस्त के पापा इंग्लिश में बोलते हैं। और मैं, तेरा पापा, चुप खड़ा रहता हूँ। तुझे प्राउड फील नहीं करवा पाता। [Because when you asked me to come to the PTM, I made excuses. Office, meetings, not feeling well. The truth was, I felt ashamed. Everyone speaks English at your school. Your friend's dad speaks English. And I, your dad, just stand there silently. I couldn't make you feel proud.]
Speaker A (Son): पापा, मुझे आप ऐसे भी अच्छे लगते हो। [Dad, I like you just the way you are.]
Speaker B (Father): पर बेटा, मैं अपने आप को अच्छा नहीं लगता था। ये गिल्ट थी। रोज़, हर बार जब तू स्कूल की बात करता था, मुझे गिल्ट होती थी। [But son, I didn't like myself. It was guilt. Every day, every time you talked about school, I felt guilty.]
Speaker A (Son): तो क्या किया पापा? [So what did you do, Dad?]
Speaker B (Father): इंग्लिश सीखो ऐप डाउनलोड किया। जनरल इंग्लिश शो खोला। 'हेलो से बात शुरू करें' पहला वीडियो देखा। 1,65,000 लोग देख चुके थे। हिंदी में समझाया था। इतना सिंपल था, पहले दिन समझ आया। [I downloaded the English Seekho app. Opened the General English show. Watched the first video 'Start talking with Hello'. 165,000 people had already watched it. It was explained in Hindi. It was so simple, I understood it on the very first day.]
Speaker A (Son): सच में पापा? [Really, Dad?]
Speaker B (Father): हाँ, फिर रोज़ के 10 इजी सेंटेंसेस देखा। 'अपने बारे में बताओ' देखा। 'My name is Ramesh. I work in a private firm. My son studies in class 5. He is a very bright student.' ये बोला मैंने। पहली बार अपने बारे में इंग्लिश में। [Yes, then I watched the daily 10 easy sentences. Watched 'Tell about yourself'. 'My name is Ramesh. I work in a private firm. My son studies in class 5. He is a very bright student.' I said this. For the first time, about myself in English.]
Speaker A (Son): फिर? [Then?]
Speaker B (Father): एआई कोच से बात की रोज़ रात को। तू सो जाता था तब। हिंदी में बोला, इंग्लिश में कैसे बोलना है बताया। 500 बार गलत बोला, 500 बार सुधारा। कभी नहीं बोला, '38 साल का है अब क्या सीखेगा?' [I spoke to the AI coach every night after you went to sleep. I spoke in Hindi, and it told me how to say it in English. I spoke incorrectly 500 times, and it corrected me 500 times. It never said, 'You are 38, what will you learn now?']
Speaker A (Son): और अब? [And now?]
Speaker B (Father): अब तेरे स्कूल चलते हैं। आज पीटीएम है ना? [Now let's go to your school. Today is the PTM, right?]
Speaker A (Son): हाँ, पर पापा, आप जाओगे? [Yes, but Dad, will you go?]
Speaker B (Father): हाँ, और आज टीचर से बात भी करूँगा। [Yes, and today I will talk to the teacher too.]
Speaker A (Son): सच में? [Really?]
Speaker B (Father): टीचर के पास गए। टीचर ने बोला, 'Hello Mr. Ramesh, how is Aarav doing at home?' मैंने बोला, 'He is doing well, ma'am. He reads every day before bed. Sometimes I read with him. He is very curious about science. I want to support him better at home. Can you suggest anything?' [We went to the teacher. The teacher said, 'Hello Mr. Ramesh, how is Aarav doing at home?' I said, 'He is doing well, ma'am. He reads every day before bed. Sometimes I read with him. He is very curious about science. I want to support him better at home. Can you suggest anything?']
Speaker A (Son): पापा, तुमने इंग्लिश में बोला! [Dad, you spoke in English!]
Speaker B (Father): हाँ बेटा, तेरी टीचर ने मेरी तरफ देखा, स्माइल किया, बोला, 'Aarav is lucky to have a father like you.' [Yes son, your teacher looked at me, smiled, and said, 'Aarav is lucky to have a father like you.']
Speaker A (Son): पापा, मुझे बहुत अच्छा लगा आज। [Dad, I felt really good today.]
Speaker B (Father): बेटा, पहले गिल्ट थी, अब प्राइड है। इंग्लिश सीखो ऐप डाउनलोड करो, जनरल इंग्लिश शो खोलो, 'हेलो से बात शुरू करें' से स्टार्ट करो। एआई कोच से रोज़ 15 मिनट प्रैक्टिस करो। एक महीने में गिल्ट प्राइड में बदल जाएगी। अपने बच्चे के लिए सीखो, वो तुमसे प्राउड होना चाहता है, उसे मौका दो। [Son, earlier there was guilt, now there is pride. Download the English Seekho app, open the General English show, start with 'Start talking with Hello'. Practice with the AI coach for 15 minutes daily. In one month, guilt will turn into pride. Learn for your child, he wants to be proud of you, give him the chance.]
Speaker C (Voiceover): तो इंस्टॉल बटन पे क्लिक करो और इंग्लिश सीखो ऐप डाउनलोड करो। [So click on the install button and download the English Seekho app.]
summary: A father shares his emotional journey of overcoming guilt and learning English to make his young son proud at school parent-teacher meetings. He explains how the English Seekho app's simple Hindi-based lessons and AI coach helped him gain confidence. The ad ends with a call to action encouraging parents to download the app for their children's sake.
